name: Hanabi
source:
A sexy and mischievous bunny girl, Hanabi is certainly used to living in-style or at least her version of it. As an infamous art thief, she's used to rolling in money but she's a free-spender even if her taste is questionable. She's proud of her sexual abilities and always takes the lead during sex. Like the other uninvited guests, she came to [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s world by accident after [url=https://vndb.org/c1785]Mikan[/url]'s teleportation.

[Edited from Wikipedia and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/33355]Ecchifan's Walkthrough[/url]]
